title: Step 58-D API client and server data foundation
description: Implement only the storefront API/server-data foundation using the existing generated OpenAPI contract as type authority: typed path/method inputs and successful responses, server-only configuration boundary, structured errors, fail-closed no-store baseline, safe GET/HEAD retry and deterministic runtime verification. Do not implement auth/session, business feature loaders, mutation orchestration, backend contract changes, Admin frontend or Step 59.

dependencies.name: Stage 58-C application shell routing RTL and i18n

acceptance_criteria.description: Storefront API request/response types derive directly from src/generated/openapi.ts generated from the canonical OpenAPI contract; no handwritten duplicate business DTO authority is introduced.
Server API base URL and timeout are read only through the canonical platform config boundary, with no hard-coded deployment URL, credentials, token or browser-public VITE secret path.
Typed transport encodes path/query/header/body inputs, returns structured successful response metadata, and normalizes canonical error envelopes without persisting raw error bodies.
Server-data baseline is no-store with stale-on-error disabled and no global cache; cache semantics for business features remain explicit future work.
Automatic retry is limited to GET/HEAD for network/timeout or 502/503/504 with maximum two attempts; mutations are never automatically retried.

Deterministic runtime verification proves typed query, UTF-8 path encoding, structured errors, safe GET retry, mutation no-retry and invalid configuration failure while existing shell and repository verification remain green.
Stage D introduces no auth/session policy, no customer feature loader, no backend/API/database mutation, no Admin frontend and no Step59 implementation.
Canonical closure requires exact-head verify/phase-a/merge-policy, artifact-bound REVIEW/LOCK, protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification before Stage E can start.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage D is MEDIUM risk. Stage E and Step59 remain forbidden until protected transport and exact-SHA postmerge verification are green.
